 Product Description
 
 

 
 
 

 

 

 
 
 Meet the Flat Snake Chain — a smooth, polished everyday essential that sits beautifully along the neckline. Its closely-linked flat mesh weave gives the chain a fluid, liquid-gold drape, while the warm gold-tone finish keeps it looking rich without ever feeling loud.
The design is deliberately clean: no fuss, no bulk, just a supple ribbon of metal that moves with you through the day. A secure lobster clasp makes it quick to put on and take off, and comfortable enough to forget you're wearing it.

• 
Flat mesh weave for a soft, snake-smooth drape

• 
Warm gold-tone finish that flatters every neckline

• 
Secure lobster clasp for easy, comfortable wear

• 
Pendant-ready — style it alone or add a charm

• Lightweight and skin-friendly for all-day wear

Wear it minimal on its own, or stack it into a layered look. However you style it, the Flat Snake Chain adds a quiet, polished finish that carries from workday to evening.
